name: joewisto-portfolio-tooling
description: Repository-wide command surface for the static Joe Wisto portfolio.

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json vite.config.mjs tools/*.mjs .github/*.md .github/*.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml schemas/*.json docs/architecture/*.md docs/decisions/*.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json vite.config.mjs tools/*.mjs .github/*.md .github/*.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml schemas/*.json docs/architecture/*.md docs/decisions/*.md
scripts.test:dist: npm run build && npm run validate:dist && uv run --locked --no-sync python tools/smoke_dist.py
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run validate && npm run test && npm run test:dist
